title: opcode.support results
description: Output of scripts/probe.mjs. Documentation, not enforced at runtime.

checkedAt.description: When the run finished. The staleness marker.

opcodes.description: Copy of config/opcodes.json, so the file is self-describing.

snippet.description: Bytecode probed. Stack inputs satisfied by PUSH0 so success means supported.

coverage.description: How much of the table reached a verdict. A drop here means endpoints degraded, not that chains changed.

byGrade.description: Cell count per evidence grade: executed, specific, generic.

snippetCheck.description: Guard against malformed snippets. suspectSnippets should always be empty.

referenceProbed.description: False means snippets went unverified this run.

suspectSnippets.description: Opcodes reported unsupported on the reference chain, which almost always means a bad snippet rather than a real gap.

chains.description: One entry per chain, TVL descending.

name.description: DefiLlama's name, kept as the display name.

rpcUrls.description: Full verified pool, operator diversified. The probe consumes it in order and stops early, so not all were contacted.

witnesses.description: Endpoints actually contacted, in the order tried.

opcodes.description: The answer. One reconciled verdict per opcode name.

tvl.description: How representative the table is. Denominators are pinned in data/chains.json when the chain list is generated, since the question is how representative the selection is rather than what TVL looks like today.

topN.description: Requested selection size. Fewer chains may appear if some had no verifiable chain id.

totalDefiUsd.description: Sum of TVL across every chain DefiLlama tracks, EVM or not.

totalEvmUsd.description: Sum across chains DefiLlama tags EVM, unioned with the chains resolved here, since that tag misses some.

selectedUsd.description: Sum across the chains in this table, scanned or not.

analyzedUsd.description: Sum across chains that produced at least one confirmed verdict. A chain we could not scan contributes nothing, however large.

unscanned.description: Chains in the table with no confirmed verdict, excluded from analyzedUsd.

witness.description: What one endpoint reported through one strategy. An endpoint appears once per strategy tried.

client.description: web3_clientVersion. Cheapest fork-change detector and the first thing to check when a verdict moves.

calibrated.description: Whether this endpoint's answers were allowed to count.

strategy.description: How the bytecode was executed. stateOverride: eth_call to a dummy address with overridden code. nullTo: eth_call with no `to`, so the data is creation code. factory: eth_call to the deterministic CREATE2 factory already deployed on the chain, with the snippet as initcode.

rejectionExample.description: Calibrated only. How this endpoint words a real opcode rejection, captured from the negative control.

rejected.description: Uncalibrated only. Why this strategy was refused. 'negative control succeeded' means the endpoint does not execute the code at all.

opcodes.description: Calibrated only. This endpoint's raw observations.

evidence.description: 'executed' on success, otherwise the verbatim node error.

reason.description: unknown only. endpoint-unavailable is a provider refusal that survived retries; unattributable-error is a failure not recognisable as an opcode rejection.

grade.description: How strong the evidence is. executed: the snippet ran. specific: the error names the opcode or instruction. generic: a bare revert, consistent with an undefined opcode but with anything else too.

verdict.description: One chain's answer for one opcode, reconciled across witnesses.

status.description: What README.md renders. Only 'confirmed' confidence yields a non-unknown status.

confidence.description: confirmed: two calibrated endpoints from different operators agreed. single-witness: only one endpoint had an opinion. single-operator: endpoints agreed but share an operator, so they are one witness. witnesses-disagree: contradiction, investigate rather than average. no-calibrated-endpoint: nothing trustworthy answered. Extra strategies on one endpoint add witnesses, never operators.

witnesses.description: Endpoints that contributed a usable observation.

operators.description: Distinct operators among them. Independence, not count, is what confirms.

observed.description: single-witness and single-operator only. What was seen, recorded but deliberately not promoted to a status.

strategies.description: Strategies that contributed. All calibrated strategies are probed, so several here means independent execution paths agreed.

grade.description: Grade of the recorded evidence. When witnesses agree, the one that names the cause is kept.

documented.description: Chains no probe can reach. A value from a primary source, kept out of `status` so it can never enter a percentage. README.md marks it with an asterisk.

note.description: Why probing fails and what the source actually says.
